title: County Prosecution
subtitle: Web-based Prosecutor Case and Document Management
descHeading: Support criminal litigation and efficiently handle special case types
descContent: Designed in accordance with the National District Attorneys Association’s Functional Requirements for Prosecutor Management Systems, InfoShare™ eProsecution is a powerful and flexible system designed specifically for County Prosecutors’ Offices and District Attorneys’ Offices to manage workloads, streamline workflows, and maintain integrity in the criminal justice process from screening to final sentencing. Expert interfacing enables seamless, NIEM-compliant data exchange and specialized modules enhance the capabilities of the existing system.

capabilities.title: Data Sharing
capabilities.desc: CSI has considerable experience in interfacing its County Prosecution applications to internal and external data sources including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, courts, family courts, municipal courts, jails, and state repositories. Our system is fully compliant with NIEM and GJ-XML data exchange standards.

capabilities.title: Total Solution
capabilities.desc: CSI solutions are powered by the InfoShare Engine®, a low-code development platform for government ERP applications. Various specialized modules enhance the capabilities of the eProsecution case and document management system. All applications and modules are unified under a single web-based system accessible via desktop and mobile platforms to meet the demands of today’s public sector agencies.

capabilities.title: Cloud Integration
capabilities.desc: InfoShare™ Cloud supports public, private, or hybrid cloud requirements, hosted on the CJIS-compliant AWS GovCloud or Azure Government—both designed for maximum government security. Moreover, OneDrive integration enables users to upload documents into the InfoShare™ system through a safe and secure channel.

capabilities.title: Security
capabilities.desc: CSI’s fully compliant security methodology ensures stringent security measures on data encryption, data exchange, wireless networking, and system access. Two-factor authentication is used to increase access security. Data access privileges are established through role- or case-based safeguards, making sure that only legitimate and authorized individuals have access to relevant functions or data.

capabilities.title: Data Analytics
capabilities.desc: Enhance decision-making, generate insights, and allocate resources efficiently to support agencies’ objectives. eProsecution data analytics analyzes internal and external data to track a variety of performance measures and includes tools such as robust search, crime analysis, data visualization, ad-hoc reporting, and much more.

items.title: Pretrial
items.desc: Support data entry, recording, and tracking of all pretrial proceedings including case initiation, initial appearance, preliminary hearing, arraignment, in-custody defendants, and pretrial events (motions, hearings, conferences, meetings, other). Manage all aspects of the case digitally: case intake, case stage, linking cases and persons, personnel assignment, scheduling, emailing, and much more.

items.title: Trial
items.desc: Handle trial proceedings including trial presentation, jury instructions, and verdict and finding. Support the litigation process with efficient organization of discovery and evidence, and with subpoenas and indictment/accusation template by statute. Assist discovery preparation with redaction and Bates numbering.

items.title: Post-Adjudication
items.desc: Assist dispositions, sentence hearings, and post-adjudication information sharing and event tracking. Use pre-assigned codes to record dispositions, manage disposition and sentencing information, support expungement, sealing, and purging of a case, and provide a function for re-opening closed cases. Provide services to victims and witnesses including support, education, guidance, compensation, and protection.

items.title: Special Case Types
items.desc: Manage special case types such as duty referral, investigation, grand jury, juvenile cases, DV family, forfeiture, guardianship, child dependency and neglect cases, motions, appeals, sex offender, and special prosecutions. Provide relevant forms, produce reports, track and provide notifications, and transfer case files to courts.

items.title: Case Support and Services
items.desc: Provide case support and services including discovery, evidence management, investigations, motions, victim services, restitution and compensation management, witness management, and diversion/deferred prosecution. Accommodate privacy and redaction needs, robust permission settings, streamlined data entry, and other specialized functions.

items.title: Additional Business Requirements
items.desc: Support additional capabilities such as master name index, merge case functions, no contact and protection orders, warrant reviews, extradition, and conflict avoidance. Monitor orders, track warrant progress, manage workflows, and more.

items.title: Common Requirements
items.desc: Manage workloads with user inbox assignment tracking and monitor office resources and processes with data analytics tools, time tracking, and performance management reporting. Expert interfacing with internal and external data sources such as law enforcement agencies, courts, state repositories, and third-parties to reduce duplicate data entry and improve data accuracy.

items.title: Nonfunctional Requirements
items.desc: County Prosecution is powered by the InfoShare Engine®, a low-code development platform for government ERP applications providing robust data encryption, stringent permission settings, cloud integration, configurable support files and business rules, streamlined reporting, template generation, and a whole suite of other features.

items.title: Document Management
items.desc: Store a wide variety of data files including documents, audio, video, and images in a configurable array of folders for efficient retrieval and review. Document files are uploaded and linked to cases with application/file type, complaint ID, file name, and a system-generated unique file number. Data files can be moved or copied to multiple case files, and multiple users can access the files simultaneously.

items.title: Charge Documents Templates
items.desc: Use a template generator to create charge documents that can be printed and stored electronically within specific cases. Support both standard and agency-specific charging languages.

items.title: Templates Generator
items.desc: Generate agency-specific forms and letters, automatically embedded with current case data. Users can edit, build, and set the approval workflow easily via the form management system.

items.title: eDiscovery
items.desc: Reduce time spent on discovery preparation by up to 75%. Documents and multimedia files including transcripts, reports, photos, audio, and video are organized in discovery packages in one central, secure repository. Create a permanent detailed record of each discovery package and its routing. Support redaction, Bates numbering, and billing.

items.title: eDiscovery with Portal
items.desc: Request, receive, and deliver discovery packages to private attorneys, district attorneys, and public defenders via a secure portal. Registered attorneys can access discovery packages anytime, anywhere.

items.title: InfoArchive
items.desc: Minimize the use of hard copies in the prosecuting agency. Digitize multiple types of office files, both case and office administration related. Digitized documents can be quickly located and returned to stakeholders for review.

items.title: InfoFile
items.desc: Remote desktop application designed to give access to Cellebrite or other formatted document types stored on shared drives. Integrated into the InfoShare™ Documents module, InfoFile allows users to view phone dump files and download exhibits for trial discovery.

items.title: InfoScribe
items.desc: Leverage the latest in AI technology to transcribe audio and video with minimal effort, reducing the amount of work in transcribing statements by at least 50%. Execute transcription processes directly from eDiscovery packages. Finished transcripts are reviewable, searchable, and linked to their corresponding case files.

items.title: InfoVideo
items.desc: Upload and download massive video data with third-party cloud integration (Evidence.com, Wasabi Storage). APIs enable user access to video footage without impacting existing bandwidth. Easily connect video data with case files.

items.title: Wasabi Storage
items.desc: Back-end cloud storage solution that integrates seamlessly into the InfoShare™ platform. Handle updates and access security enhancements. Integrate with InfoVideo, InfoRecording, InfoDoc, and eDiscovery with Portal.

items.title: Interview Recording
items.desc: Conduct live remote interviews and store recordings directly in the case file after the interview is completed. Compatible with most HD cameras and high-quality synchronized audio channels. Manage multiple interviews from one recording station. Users can add additional metadata to the files.

items.title: Investigation
items.desc: Manage investigations with an extensive range of information such as reports, evidence, contacts, assignments, arrests, warrants, and more. Document specialized investigation data including arson, burglary, death, narcotics, robbery, sexual assault, and vehicle crashes.

items.title: Crime Analysis
items.desc: Advanced data collection and analytics to transform vast amounts of stored data into meaningful and insightful information, revealing crime trends and hidden patterns. Visualize data to draw connections to and between crimes, people, places, and vehicles.

items.title: High Tech Crime
items.desc: Document computer forensic and other technology-related investigations. Identify, preserve, analyze, and document digital evidence for investigative management.

items.title: Duty Referral
items.desc: Designed to help record, categorize, review, and track all case information including initial referral, location, type of incident as well as victim, witness, and suspect data. Assign staff, conduct preliminary assessments, generate tracking reports, and perform supervisory reviews to determine the appropriate course of action.

items.title: Major Incident Management
items.desc: Facilitate large scale investigations involving multiple operations, jurisdictions, and/or leads, including but not limited to terrorist incidents, mass casualty incidents, and crime spree investigations. Robust permission settings ensure that sensitive data is secure and only accessible by authorized personnel.

items.title: Professional Standards & IA
items.desc: Manage and document investigations of alleged officer and/or employee misconduct to maintain agency integrity. Data is stored in a separate database for increased security. Supports external user management, early intervention mechanism, customizable workflows, standardized disciplinary forms, and more.

items.title: Brady-Giglio
items.desc: Designed to assist in complying with the United States Supreme Court decision in Brady v. Maryland, 373 U.S. 83, 87 (1963). Provide a mechanism to classify and track personnel subject to Brady-Giglio reporting. A permission-controlled Master Officer Search controls access to records in the database.

items.title: Drug Screening Randomizer
items.desc: Generate lists of randomly selected personnel who are eligible for drug screening. All employees in the agency have an equal chance of being selected each and every time a selection takes place. Support all required documentation and archiving needs.

items.title: Confidential Informants/Witnesses
items.desc: Manage information and documents on confidential informants and cooperating witnesses. Record contact logs, intelligence, payments, and more. Robust permission settings ensure that only authorized individuals have access to confidential records.

items.title: Crime Scene Investigation
items.desc: Document the collection, processing, and findings of forensic evidence for investigations and court proceedings. Manage chain of custody and current repository of crime scene data linked to cases, keeping all data organized and updated for quick access.

items.title: Intelligence
items.desc: A 28 CFR Part 23 compliant criminal intelligence system to store, access, and analyze intelligence at the local, state, and federal level for crime prevention and investigative purposes. Global Search and ALPR data interfaces provide extensive capabilities in searching and linking information.

items.title: Juvenile
items.desc: Case and document management designed specifically for Juvenile Units to screen, investigate, and prosecute juvenile offenders. Enhance communication and data sharing among assistant prosecutors, investigators, clerical staff, victim-witness advocates, and special units. Also supports additional security and privacy requirements for juvenile cases.

items.title: DV Family
items.desc: Assist Domestic Violence Units in investigating and prosecuting cases of domestic violence from inception to disposition. Handle contacts, staff assignments, warrants, victim services, events, orders of protection, and more.

items.title: JV Screening
items.desc: Upload juvenile case information and supporting documents from local police departments or municipal court systems (e.g. eCDR) to prosecutor’s offices, shortening the time to receive arrest information while speeding up time to trial. The workflow can be customized to include Juvenile Probation and/or Family Court Staff.

items.title: JV ePetition
items.desc: Electronic filing of juvenile petitions with Juvenile and Family Courts describing the charges filed against the juvenile offender.

items.title: Appellate
items.desc: Handle case information and activities through the appellate process. Enter appeal type, update appeal and disposition information, record or schedule events, add appeal motions, and assign staff. In addition, case information can be easily shared from one system to another if the case is transferred to another agency.

items.title: Motion
items.desc: Track and manage all case facts in preparation of motion workflows. Enter motion type, update motion and disposition information, track filing dates, organize oral arguments, assign staff, and provide alerts and notifications to ensure smooth motion proceedings.

items.title: Evidence
items.desc: Comprehensive, automated evidence management customized to fit the protocols of each agency. Manage the evidence process, add related persons and related police officers, log evidence, and use barcode technology to ensure accuracy in tracking chain of custody.

items.title: LIMS
items.desc: Manage laboratory-related discovery including but not limited to toxicology, seized drugs, firearms, latent prints, and trace. Log lab evidence, manage the lab evidence process, track chain of custody, and record lab analysis results. Also, generate a wide variety of lab and ballistics analysis reports.

items.title: Forfeiture
items.desc: Create itemized lists of asset forfeitures including property, vehicles, and contraband according to the state guidelines. Track funds’ account statement, cash distribution, disposition, and expenditures. Automatically generate quarterly reports on seizures and forfeiture activity.

items.title: Megan's Law
items.desc: Manage sex offender profile, registration status, and case information for organized input, display, and search retrieval. The module includes a tier assessment tool for prosecutor proposal and court approval. Send notifications based on a tier rating system to applicable schools and organizations.

items.title: DV Weapon
items.desc: Enter and track weapons seized from domestic violence incidents. Allow authorized local police departments to enter weapons prior to delivery to the prosecutor’s office. Track the legal life cycle of the weapons to include owners, destruction, etc., and link to related DV Family cases.

items.title: Fugitive
items.desc: Special case management module for warrants, fugitives, and extraditions. Manage fugitive documentation including charges, plea offers, parole/probation, restraining orders, aliases, vehicles, associations, and much more.

items.title: Civil Module
items.desc: Handle civil cases in which plaintiffs seek monetary compensation. Create events and send events to Outlook Calendar. Complete integration with InfoShare™ eDiscovery with Portal.

items.title: Finance Module
items.desc: Track budget, grant, fund, and billing with purchase requisition and purchase order process. Use CSI’s proprietary data migration process to convert data from existing databases.

items.title: Personnel & Scheduling
items.desc: Support all aspects of personnel management such as training, time off, overtime, document tracking, and scheduling. Extensive searching and analytical reporting for both attendance and payroll purposes provide an easy way to manage any contractual rules offices may have.

items.title: Pawn Shop
items.desc: Record and track pawn stores, sellers, tickets, articles, and success stories. Multiple kinds of seller alerts and stolen items alerts are utilized for tracking burglary.

items.title: Marijuana / Alcohol
items.desc: Record and track marijuana and alcohol usage and generate warning forms for underage persons as well as host warning data and forms in the prosecutor’s office to complete the purge/review function as required by law.

items.title: VW Services
items.desc: Easily track services provided to victims of crime. Services provided include supporting victims’ needs, educating victims about their rights, assisting with forms, and navigating criminal justice proceedings. All information is confidential and populated into VOCA reports.

items.title: VW Stat Tracker
items.desc: Designed to simplify state and federal statistical reporting requirements. Forms and reports such as VOCA, PMT, and VAWA are automatically updated when information is added to a case, streamlining the reporting process and saving valuable time when applying for grants.

items.title: VW Info Portal
items.desc: Secure website for victims and witnesses to receive court notifications, submit forms and letters, check case status, access services, upload documents and images, and securely communicate with advocates using the Portal note feature.

items.title: Adult VW Letter
items.desc: Generate a series of Victim/Witness Letters produced and printed overnight. Letter type and production command are made on the basis of staff entry, case add, events, and dispositions from automated interfaces with Courts.

items.title: JV VW Letter
items.desc: Set of victim and victim survivor letters produced and printed in batch overnight. Letter type and production based upon daily input into the Juvenile module in key fields of events, charges, dispositions, warrants, and fugitive status.

items.title: DV VW Letter
items.desc: Generate a series of DVF Victim Witness letters produced and printed overnight. Letter type and production command made on the basis of case add, events, and dispositions from the automated FACTS interface with the system.

items.title: Child Advocacy Center
items.desc: Support multidisciplinary teams comprised of child advocates, victim-witness advocates, and detectives to investigate crime and deliver services as well as resources to victims and their families. Track CAC cases, add suspect information, assign CAC staff, prepare investigation reports, and export data to NCA Stats Reports and VOCA Reports.

items.title: Sexual Assault
items.desc: Specialized investigation services for sexual assault cases. Includes additional data fields, additional search capabilities, and report templates consistent with Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) PMT and Sexual Assault Response and Referrals requirements.

items.title: Project Direct
items.desc: Establish a county-wide tracking system for victim assistance program(s) to provide direct services and increase community engagement at local police departments. Project Direct staff can customize each report/grant based on agency requirements and services provided.

items.title: PMT Report
items.desc: Collect information required to prepare Performance Measurement Tool (PMT) reports for compliance, decision-making, and reporting purposes. Entries are automatically updated when information is added to the case. Can be combined with Investigation sex crime submodule to enhance search, populate reports, and track services.

items.title: VAWA / Muskie Report
items.desc: Support the submission of the VAWA/Muskie Report. Categories in Section D (Victim Services/Legal Services) are automatically entered into the report from the system.

items.title: InfoVNS Mobile App
items.desc: Allow mobile access to vital case information, guidance, notifications, direct services, and resources anytime, anywhere. Mapping and navigation capabilities help victims and witnesses quickly find resources.

title: Courts
subtitle: Complete Case and Document Management Solution
descHeading: Comprehensive case handling system from docketing to disposition
descContent: InfoShare™ Courts is a case and document management tool offering court staff a workflow-based case handling platform. Docketing, assignments, document handling, notifications, calendaring, and dispositions are all recorded clearly and conveniently. Online order generation and opinion publishing along with extensive search capabilities, reporting, notifications, and analytics are all built in.
highlights: Efficient case intake and document management tool
Designed to handle all case types
Built-in case workflow and reporting capability
Full search features including ad hoc searching

sysFeatures.title: Case Management
sysFeatures.desc: Efficient case processing allows staff to focus on important tasks. Cases can transfer electronically between courts, eliminating redundant data entry. Complexities such as calendaring, disqualifications, case and document sealing, and opinion handling are all accommodated.
list: Configurable support files and business rules
Role-based permission settings restrict access to sensitive cases
Electronic document management including file stamping
Judge, vicinage, and party contact management

sysFeatures.title: Streamlined Workflow
sysFeatures.desc: A workflow-optimized user interface improves investigative staff productivity. Users can quickly locate caseload information, add case events, create reports, or view assignments and active cases from a single window.

sysFeatures.title: Extensive Search Capabilities
sysFeatures.desc: Given the wealth of cases, documents, multimedia files, and reports, investigative staff need powerful search capabilities to quickly and easily find the necessary information.
list: Extensive global and local search options

sysFeatures.title: Template Generation & Reporting
sysFeatures.desc: Customizable templates generated with one click for a wide variety of reports. Users can create and export reports in PDF or Excel format. InfoShare™ Courts supports templates for automated notifications, orders, and more.
list: Permission levels restrict access to sensitive reports

sysFeatures.title: Document Archiving
sysFeatures.desc: InfoShare™ Courts also includes the option of archiving case materials, providing substantial savings on costly paper storage. Case jackets can be uploaded and retained for any length of time mandated by the state.
list: Off-site transport and warehousing cost savings

quote.content: The goal is to turn data into information and information into insight

title: Courts eFiling
subtitle: Secure Portal for Electronic Case and Payment Handling
descHeading: Process submitted cases, documents, communications, and filing fees electronically
descContent: Fully integrated with InfoShare™ Court Case Management, the Courts eFiling module provides an easy to use and convenient 24x7 system for filers of all case types. Carefully crafted to guide filers through case creation, supplemental document filing, attorney substitutions, and all aspects of today’s cases. Electronic notifications and communications are provided, and filing fees are handled through a secure online payment process.

sysFeatures.title: Electronic Document Filing
sysFeatures.desc: A fully synchronized Portal allows filers to create and upload documents online anytime, anywhere. Documents are submitted to the Court for review immediately after filing and date/time stamped with the status. Parties have access to case documents filed by other parties.

sysFeatures.title: Ease of Case Processing for Court Staff
sysFeatures.desc: eFiled documents are pre-sorted into staff inboxes allowing for efficient case processing. Case and document statuses are automatically updated for the filer. Electronic document transfer and storage minimizes physical file handling.
list: Immediate document review and status assignment

sysFeatures.title: Credit Card Payment Handling
sysFeatures.desc: Easily pay fees by credit card, eliminating time consuming check handling done by court staff. Comprehensive audit trail records allow for easy tracing of any payment. A full suite of reports is included for accounting purposes.

title: Attorney Ethics
subtitle: Enforcing Good Attorney Standards
descHeading: Full application suite to maintain ethical attorney behavior
descContent: In certain circumstances, attorney actions may be challenged by clients, and InfoShare™ Attorney Ethics provides a way of adjudicating these matters. For attorneys found to have contravened ethical practices, or to have committed felonies, disciplinary action can be taken. Additionally, fee disputes can be reviewed and settled. A random audit system reviews attorney accounting to make sure that client funds are managed properly.

sysFeatures.title: Disciplinary Hearings with Portal
sysFeatures.desc: Schedule disciplinary hearings; assign disciplinary board members, presenters, and attorney counsel; and record board determinations. Discipline or reinstatement decisions can be viewed by the public via the Portal.

sysFeatures.title: Fee Arbitration & Fee/Ethics Appeals
sysFeatures.desc: Seamless fee arbitration process to handle fee disputes from appealing a determination. Similarly, ethics appeals can be processed, with original hearing documents transferred from the original hearing agency.
list: Full vote of board members and recusals

sysFeatures.title: Random Audits
sysFeatures.desc: Random audits of attorney firms to ensure maximum accountability. Generate pre-audit template checklists and data sheets, assign auditors, and schedule assignments and follow up visits where necessary.
list: No repeats in random audit selection

sysFeatures.title: eFiling
sysFeatures.desc: Enable district offices to docket matters and make staff assignments remotely, saving on paper, postage, and time. Costs assessed and other penalties can be paid electronically, and appeals can also be filed.
list: Online payment of fees or fines

title: eDiscovery with Portal
subtitle: Efficient Preparation and Delivery of Discovery Files
descHeading: Reduce time spent on discovery preparation by up to 75%
descContent: A modern, paperless approach to creating, viewing, organizing, and delivering discovery files. Documents and other multimedia files including transcripts, documents, photos, audio, video, and reports are organized in discovery packages in one central, secure repository. With the eDiscovery Portal, registered attorneys can easily request and receive discovery packages.

carousels.title: PDF Conversion
carousels.desc: Convert all discoverable documents that are scanned, uploaded, or generated in the system into a PDF  file to ensure the document(s) integrity.

carousels.title: Discovery Packages
carousels.desc: Organize documents and other multimedia files into discovery packages quickly and easily, saving valuable time and money.

carousels.title: Redaction & Bates Numbering
carousels.desc: Protect privileged information with redaction and add bates numbers for easy identification and retrieval. Original documents can be viewed next to redacted copies.

carousels.title: Multimedia Files & Billing
carousels.desc: Manage all discovery files, documents, images, and audio/video recordings together with billing in one central, secure location.

carousels.title: eDiscovery Portal
carousels.desc: Request, receive, and deliver discovery packages to registered private attorneys, district attorneys, and public defenders via a secure portal.

carousels.title: Video Discovery
carousels.desc: Handle massive video data with third-party cloud integration (Evidence.com, Wasabi). APIs enable user access to video footage without impacting existing bandwidth.

title: Victim Witness Suite with Portal
subtitle: Full Service Suite for Victim Advocates and Crime Victims
descHeading: Expedite services and communication for victims
descContent: The Victims of Crime Act (VOCA) of 1984 was established to ensure victims are treated with fairness, compassion, and respect. The Victim Witness Suite with Portal serves as an invaluable resource for Victim Advocates and Crime Victims. Benefits include helping monitor and manage advocate caseloads, meeting the needs of victims, educating victims of their rights, enhancing communication, complying with state and federal regulations, and many more. Ultimately, advocates spend less time on paperwork and more time focusing on victim support.

sysFeatures.title: Customizable Automated Letter Generation
sysFeatures.desc: The Victim Witness Suite is seamlessly integrated with InfoShare™. Case information only needs to be entered once to become available for use in forms, reports, and other documents. Letters can be customized and automatically generated based on court events and their outcomes.

sysFeatures.title: Court Events and Trigger Settings
sysFeatures.desc: Victim Witness letters are generated daily based on trigger settings and court events/outcomes. Advocates can set specific triggers and review the letters generated for the day. Letters can be mailed, emailed, or sent to the Portal.

sysFeatures.title: Victim Services Tab
sysFeatures.desc: Easily track services provided to victims of crime. Services provided include supporting victims’ needs, educating victims of their rights, assisting with forms, and navigating the criminal justice proceedings. All information is confidential and populated into VOCA reports.

sysFeatures.title: Stat Tracker
sysFeatures.desc: Stat is designed to simplify state and federal statistical reporting requirements. Forms and reports are automatically updated when information is added to a case, streamlining the reporting process and saving valuable time.
list: Sexual Assault Response and Referrals Report
Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) PMT Report

sysFeatures.title: Victim Witness Portal
sysFeatures.desc: A secure website for Victims and Witnesses to receive court notifications, instantly access forms and letters, check the status of a case, and securely communicate with Advocates using the Portal note feature.
list: Quick access to victim contact letters and court proceedings
Instant access to forms (victim impact statement, sentencing, plea, etc.)
Communication with advocates via portal note

sysFeatures.title: InfoVNS Mobile App
sysFeatures.desc: Allows access via any mobile device so that Victims and Witnesses can get vital information on cases, court events, and resources anytime, anywhere. The app shares all the same functions as the Portal plus mapping and navigation for quick access to resources.
list: Quick and easy access to case information

title: Interview Recording
subtitle: Integrated Interview Room A/V Recording Software
descHeading: Conduct remote interviews and store recordings directly in the case file
descContent: Equipped with comprehensive features for managing interview recordings, the application seamlessly integrates with InfoShare™ so recordings are stored directly in the case file after the interview is completed. The Windows-based application launches right from the user’s computer, requires no special housing/recording system, and is compatible with most HD cameras and high-quality synchronized audio. Live interviews can also be viewed from the web and from iOS-supported smartphones and tablets.

sysFeatures.title: One System Recording
sysFeatures.desc: Efficiently manage multiple interrogations and interview rooms from one recording station. The system accommodates up to four channels, allowing up to four video input devices from different locations.

sysFeatures.title: Viewing/Recording Features
sysFeatures.desc: Users can quickly launch a recording session, manage the interview with recording features, review annotations, and control remote live broadcasting for authorized users (desktop, web, iOS-compatible devices).
list: Watermark with date, time, and case number

sysFeatures.title: Storage/Playback of Interview
sysFeatures.desc: With CSI’s patented InfoShare Engine®, all applications and modules benefit from seamless integration. Interview recordings are linked directly to an agency’s case file or discovery package. They can also be burned to a disc or saved on the local system.

title: Online Transcription Service
subtitle: Transcription with Minimal Effort and Complete Integration
descHeading: Save thousands of hours with automated audio and video transcriptions
descContent: Leverage the latest in AI technology to transcribe audio and video with minimal effort, reducing the amount of work in transcribing statements by at least 50%. Execute transcription processes directly from eDiscovery packages. Finished transcripts are reviewable, searchable, and linked to their corresponding case files.

sysFeatures.title: Rapid First Draft
sysFeatures.desc: Produce a rough transcript in minutes using cloud-based speech translation powered by machine learning. First drafts are up to 80% accurate. Government cloud infrastructure offers enterprise-grade security and CJIS compliance.
list: Azure Artificial Intelligence and Government Cloud

sysFeatures.title: Transcriber Efficiency and Editing
sysFeatures.desc: Designed with quality-focused editing tools and functions. Each line is timestamped with a confidence level, and lines below a certain confidence level are automatically highlighted for review. Integrated keyboard and foot pedal controls maximize transcriber efficiency.
list: Integrated transcriber keyboard and foot pedal controls
Search, jump, rollback, flag, last review, and spell-check functions

sysFeatures.title: Seamless Integration
sysFeatures.desc: Users can execute transcription tasks, review, correct, and view transcripts directly from eDiscovery folders within a case file. Finished transcripts are searchable and automatically linked to audio, video, or interview recordings uploaded to the system in a compatible format.
list: Launch, review, and correct directly from case files
